name: DOBOT
summary:
DOBOT (Yuejiang) develops collaborative robots, desktop robot arms and embodied-intelligence platforms. Its engineering includes integrated drive-and-control technology, robot motion control and safety systems. The portfolio serves industrial production, education and commercial automation, connecting compact robot products with larger manufacturing solutions.

The company has expanded into humanoid and consumer robotics alongside its established arm business. Its international operations support customers through product development, application integration and services. Typical application areas include electronics, automotive manufacturing, metal processing, food and beverages, retail and teaching.
